summary: Short residential kerb with parked cars; apartments 15-16 m away on own side.

best_section.where: Ada Street north kerb, west end near the bend

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 15-16 m behind the kerb on the same side and homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along the kerb; room to stop at the edge.
drivers.convention: Cars regularly park along both kerbs, so a van blends in.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy shades the kerb, mainly from the north.
